newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-SAMPRAS GLIDES THROUGH OPEN FIRST ROUND.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SAMPRAS GLIDES THROUGH OPEN FIRST ROUND.

text.p: World number one Pete Sampras glided into the second round of the Australian Open on Tuesday, beating hapless Romanian Dinu Pescariu in straight sets.
In a relief for tournament organisers, who have lost some of their biggest names from the men's draw, including defending champion Boris Becker, Sampras beat Pescariu 6-2 6-4 6-2.

Pescariu, a 22-year-old qualifier, was merely a warm-up for the top seed, who is hunting down his second Australian Open victory after last year's shock third-round exit to Australian Mark Philippoussis.

Sampras, who arrived at last year's Open suffering influenza, has been untroubled going into the Open, his only slip-up being a loss to world number two and compatriot Michael Chang in an exhibition event last week.
